bullets.text: Researching and implementing Java-based utilization optimizations for Amazon Redshift
Rebuilt the legacy UI of a test-data workflow builder in React, Electron, and TypeScript, adding Jest-tested workflow validation and a React-Flow editor; rated 90% satisfaction vs.\ the old tool
Built a precomputed tree-style workflow search index to minimize DB queries under access limits, distilling popular workflows from a 270K+ row PostgreSQL table via Python/SQLAlchemy and Redis
Cut workflow generation time 65% to under 15s with a Claude skill using sub-skill decomposition and Python search/validation tools, guided by CloudWatch + OpenSearch latency logs
Shipped an Amazon Leo space-research tool adopted into Leo's ecosystem, deployed on Docker + AWS Fargate via GitHub Actions, with AWS CDK (TypeScript) infra so new engineers can contribute
Sped up a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped research documents to inference by 34% with Kinesis streams feeding Lambda processors, exposed to the app via API Gateway
Automated fine-tuning of an AWS Bedrock source-relevancy model with EventBridge cron triggers and decision gates that skip redundant retraining; added X-Ray tracing and SNS failure alerts
Developing automated training for PhysTwin, a physics-based digital twin, with a PhD team targeting ICLR
Engineered a Python pipeline rendering AnyGrasp multi-camera grasp candidates as Open3D overlays for a Qwen3-VL-8B vision-language model, letting researchers isolate scene components
Reduced research-environment setup time 30% with uv dependency pinning and Docker, plus psutil time/memory profiling and Pytest suites to locate bottlenecks
Co-founded and scaled a 110+ member campus product studio shipping 5 live products, run as agile teams
Developed Prisma-based SQL querying with Redis query caching for Tortuga, a class scheduler that drew 20,000+ visits in its first 30 days, to reduce DB load and latency
Building a RAG meal-suggestion feature for the official UMD app with GPT-4o mini over ChromaDB + SentenceBERT recipe search; 93% meal satisfaction among internal testers (in progress)
Implemented a C++ order-book simulator on historical IEX data with a contract-based plug-in design, so alternative approaches can be swapped in with correctness enforced
Designed paginated hash-based storage for live order-book data with an in-memory LFU cache for hot tickers, evaluated for drift against IEX historical book data
Benchmarked a time-based adaptive LSM store against a B+ tree for simulation logs, measuring throughput and latency with rdtscp and hardware utilization with Linux perf
